We limit these family-friendly events to 40 people so attendees get plenty of scope time, have a chance to ask questions and talk to our experienced docents, and learn about the astronomical object that is the focus of the event. services.name: Bring Your Own Telescope Class
services.desc: Have a telescope you’re not quite sure how to use, or maybe you haven’t used in years? Bring it to this hands-on, confidence-building workshop designed to help you get the most out of your stargazing experience! Whether you’ve just unboxed your first telescope or inherited a beloved but unfamiliar scope, this class will give you the skills and understanding you need to explore the night sky with ease. We’ll begin with a friendly, beginner-focused introduction to the different types of telescopes, how they work, and the essential components you should know. services.name: Docent / Member Parties
services.desc: Welcome to a celestial soiree under the stars! Several times a year the Robert Ferguson Observatory hosts themed, enchanted evenings as we invite our dedicated docents and esteemed members and their guests to an exclusive, open house-style event at our observatory. Whether it’s “Treats & Trivia,” “Scoops & Scopes,” or “Cider & Stars,” each night is sure to bring fun, education, and interesting conversation! Put your space knowledge to the test in an evening of astronomy-themed fun! From celestial phenomena to rockets, satellites, and iconic sci-fi, our three-round trivia game will challenge beginners and seasoned stargazers alike.
